analysis.title: CAS Mark to Market for Friday - 30 Oct 2026
key_insights: Risk moved lower into the weekend but bounced off the intraday lows into the close. NDX had its worst session since June as the AI trade sold off after earnings over the past couple of days.
Credit spreads widened with the equity move, but credit outperformed stocks after underperforming the previous day following the equity close.
Rates finished mixed with a steeper curve, driven by equity weakness. The market prices 18bps of hikes through year-end and about 60bps through mid-2027.
The Dollar weakened against most G10 peers for the week. EUR was the only G10 currency to trade lower on the day and ended the week at its lowest level since May 2025.
Defensive sectors outperformed in the equity sell-off: Energy +1.91%, Consumer Staples +1.38%, Utilities +0.64%, Healthcare +0.43%, Real Estate +0.15%, Materials +0.04%.
The GS AI Semis basket (GSCBSMHX) fell 8.25% and the GS Data Center basket (GSTMTDAT) fell 7.35% for the week. Tech sector fell 4.24% on the session.
In credit, TMT underperformed, led by hyperscalers. AI-related CDS closed 2-10bps wider. VRRM HY bonds fell 9 points and CRWV cash fell another 1-2 points.
Next week's calendar: October payrolls, ISM manufacturing and services, the November QRA (Treasury refunding), and the midterm elections.
earnings_insights: AI-related earnings over the past couple of days are cited as the trigger for the AI trade sell-off. No specific company EPS or revenue figures are given.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Released the morning of 30 Oct, in line with expectations, so it did not drive rates.

macro_indicators.indicator: Market-implied Fed hikes through end of 2026
macro_indicators.interpretation: Market pricing, not a Fed projection. The market is pricing rate hikes rather than cuts.
Market pricing of further tightening into next year.

risk_factors: The AI trade is under pressure following earnings, with hyperscaler and AI-related credit spreads widening.
The rates bid stalled in the afternoon despite the equity weakness.
Event risk next week from payrolls, ISM, the November QRA and the midterm elections.
vol_and_positioning: Volumes in rates ran about 132% above recent averages on a busy month-end session.
CDX IG widened 0.64bps and CDX HY fell 20 cents in decompression flows.
In one-delta credit flows there was short covering at the intraday wides. Vol inquiries were mostly sellers of tail IG downside.
Rates saw better paying of rate from fast money, and buyers of spreads into the risk-off tightening.
JPY gains reflected the risk-off tone in equities, which the desk says shows its hedge value.
geopolitical: Oil prices climbed overnight, which lifted NOK.
The BOJ held policy as widely expected, with a muted USDJPY reaction.
